```yaml
name: Check Discord Invite Link

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */12 * * *'   # every 12 hours
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  issues: write

jobs:
  check-link:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      INVITE_CODE: f2AjwV2AN
      REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
    steps:
      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Validate Discord invite
        run: |
          # Check the invite status
          STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://discord.com/api/v10/invites/${INVITE_CODE})
          echo "Discord invite status: $STATUS"

          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 200 ]; then
            echo "Invite link is invalid. Checking for existing issues."

            # Check for open issues with the discord-link label
            EXISTING=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
              -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/issues?state=open&labels=discord-link" | jq 'length')

            if [ "$EXISTING" -gt 0 ]; then
              echo "An open issue with label discord-link already exists. Skipping issue creation."
            else
              echo "No existing issue found. Creating new issue."

              # Create a new issue
              curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
                -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
                -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
                -d "$(printf '{"title":"Discord invite link is invalid","body":"The Discord invite link discord.gg/%s is returning HTTP status code %s. Please investigate.","labels":["discord-link"]}' "$INVITE_CODE" "$STATUS")" \
                "https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/issues"
            fi
          else
            echo "Invite link is valid."
          fi
```
